title: Sweet As
style: Indie-pop with a bouncy swung drum groove, warm bass, and jangly guitar chops; verse stays light and conversational, pre-chorus strips to bass and handclaps, chorus opens with stacked harmonies and a chantable hook. Lead vocal is close-mic and cheeky, with doubled lines on key phrases and little ad-lib echoes. Ear candy includes clipped whistle hits, reverse guitar swells into the chorus, and a shimmer riser before the final lift. Mix is bright, clean, and punchy with a laid-back coastal feel.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Pulled up in my old Ute
Got a pie from the dairy
Blue skies over the bay
And the boys all said, “Choice, mate”

You asked how I’m tracking
I said “Yep, all good, bro”
If the day’s a bit cooked
We’ll still give it a go

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t be a drongo
Come along for the ride
Grab a cold one, eh
And keep it easy inside

[Chorus]
Sweet as, sweet as
That’s the way we roll
Yeah nah, yeah nah
You already know
Sweet as, sweet as
When the weekend lands
Sweet as, sweet as
With the sand in our hands

[Verse 2]
Jandals on the deck
And a hangi on the way
A mate says, “Too easy”
Then he’s off for the day

If the plan goes sideways
We’ll laugh and carry on
Nothing needs explaining
When the sun stays strong

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t be a drongo
Come along for the ride
Grab a cold one, eh
And keep it easy inside

[Chorus]
Sweet as, sweet as
That’s the way we roll
Yeah nah, yeah nah
You already know
Sweet as, sweet as
When the weekend lands
Sweet as, sweet as
With the sand in our hands

[Bridge]
Out past the driveway
Past the hill and the fence
Everyone’s a legend
In a no-fuss sense

Say what you mean
Keep a grin, keep pace
One good yarn
And we’re set in place

[Final Chorus]
Sweet as, sweet as
That’s the way we roll
Yeah nah, yeah nah
You already know
Sweet as, sweet as
When the weekend lands
Sweet as, sweet as
With the sand in our hands
